description_en: Use this operation to reset the password for the administrator account of a database. For enhanced security, change your password regularly
description_zh: 如果数据库的密码安全性较差，您也可以通过调用此接口可以修改数据库administrator账号的密码。为了数据库的安全，建议您定期更改数据库密码
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open reset-database-account-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --account-password Password0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetDatabaseAccountPassword

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The new password for the administrator account
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request, contain only ASCII characters, and not exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
